verdict.rationale: Supabase's Dashboard-integrated AI Assistant generates SQL, offers schema design guidance, and gives contextual feedback/recommendations while working on a table, and Advisors surface deterministic findings (missing indexes, RLS misconfigurations) that an agent or user can pull inline. However, this is schema/query assistance rather than clear evidence of AI analyzing actual row-level data content to produce insights (e.g., trends, anomalies), and there's no independent/hands-on corroboration of the AI Assistant's data-insight quality. Missing for 10: evidence of AI-generated insights derived from actual stored data (not just schema/SQL), and independent verification of the Assistant's usefulness.
